_doc: Render massing for the Newfoundland Memorial (caribou on a granite cairn, Gentsesteenweg; OSM historic=memorial, Q5178692), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB KNW 2384 (cultuur-historisch monument) got 25 m from the DHMV II DSM: the poplars around it. Look (Street View from the N43, look-up only): a grey granite cairn of about 4 m with a bronze caribou on top, about 6.5 m in all.
